svg.title: C04: Broker
svg.desc: Analytical UML class view of the proposed pattern contract; not an observed implementation or execution trace.
svg.text: Communication / UML CLASS VIEW / ANALYTICAL MODEL

text.tspan: Mediate discovery and invocation across boundaries.

svg.text: dashed arrow: call dependency · brown: return/failure · analytical, not an observed trace

text.tspan: A caller invokes a service or provider without direct construction.
A service description is registered or a request is addressed.
Registry, service description, transport, request/reply, and error mapping.
Broker resolves a compatible endpoint and returns a correlated response.
Provider identity and versioned service description are available.
Client and provider agree on schema or return incompatibility.
Broker discovery does not bypass authentication or trust boundaries.
Provider absence, timeout, partial reply, and schema mismatch are explicit.
1 Client → Broker request(capability)
2 Broker → ServiceDescription lookup(service)
3 ServiceDescription ↩ Broker return(provider)
4 Broker → Transport invoke(request)
5 Transport → Provider call(service)
6 Provider ↩ Transport return(response)
7 Transport ↩ Broker return(response)
8 Broker → Client reply(result)
Tool registry, provider registry, cross-process broker, and service mesh.
Test discovery, missing provider, version mismatch, timeout, and reconnect.
A local factory returning implementations is only a registry cue.
